ATI Inc 2020 full year results Aerospace & Defense sales decline operating margin

findings.claim: 2020疫情下行期：Q3 2020 HPMC航太國防銷售年減55%（商用航太-64%），Q3 ATI調整後EBITDA僅16.6百萬美元、占銷售2.8%。
findings.excerpt: Sales to the aerospace & defense markets, which represented 78% of third quarter 2020 HPMC sales, were 55% lower, primarily resulting from a 64% decrease in sales to the commercial aerospace market

findings.claim: 2020全年銷售29.8億美元，調整後EBITDA 196.3百萬美元（6.6%）；Q4 HPMC商用航太銷售-68%，HPMC段EBITDA率3.4%（前年同期18.7%）；管理層稱Q4營收季增10%為最差已過的跡象。
findings.excerpt: Q4 revenue increased 10% to $658 million versus Q3 levels. We see this as a further indication of stabilization in our key end markets and a sign that the worst of the lingering aerospace downturn is behind us.
